goal: Prevent data races when concurrent IPC worker threads submit solutions while reading active block templates
Allow external mining clients to fetch total template fees directly instead of summing individual fees
agreement: Substantive support for resolving the race condition and adding the fee query (ismaelsadeeq, enirox001)
Verified the race fix with a concurrent template access test under ThreadSanitizer (enirox001)
Suggested making templates immutable instead of locking, deferred due to IPC latency benchmarks (sedited)
Concept and code approval without detailed comments (w0xlt)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it fixes a data race when concurrent IPC worker threads access templates during block submission
Improves stability and completeness of the mining interface relied on by external Stratum v2 clients
